candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to owner with a no-op (remove assignment), so transferOwnership no longer updates owner.
Change assignment to assign zero address instead of newOwner, so owner becomes address(0) after transferOwnership.
Remove the onlyOwner check (drops the require), allowing anyone to call transferOwnership and change owner.
Invert the assignment to set owner to the caller instead of the provided newOwner, so owner becomes msg.sender.
Insert a statement in owned() that transfers ownership to caller, changing owner after owned() is called.

Replace the require check in onlyOwner to require msg.sender != owner, inverting the guard so owned() can be called by non-owners and leaving owner unchanged (observable difference because calls by original owner will revert but non-owner calls succeed).
Replaced assignment to owner with a no-op (commented out) so transferOwnership no longer updates owner.
Replaced assignment to owner with assigning to address(0), making owner always zero address after transferOwnership.
Removed the onlyOwner guard body require, allowing anyone to call transferOwnership and change owner.
Replaced require check to compare msg.sender to address(0), effectively preventing legitimate owners from passing the guard and blocking transfers.
